answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 65619 Country: India Title: Can we take alcoholic homoeopathic medicine Question: Can we take alcoholic homoeopathic medicine BERBERIS VULGARIS for kidney stones? Answer ID: 65619 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 955/1020/L=09/1437) The alcohol which nowadays is mixed in the medicines is extracted from things other than grapes and dates such as wheat, potato, petrol etc hence at the time of need such medicines may be used. However, it is better to avoid them. كما في تكملة فتح الملهم. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
